newsitem.title: USA: PharmaKinetics Lab in $1.4 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: PharmaKinetics Lab in $1.4 mln contract.

text.p: PharmaKinetics Laboratories Inc said Monday it signed a $1.4 million contract to manage a clinical trial for an unnamed generic drug firm.
The project is expected to begin this fall and run through most of 1998, PharmaKinetics said in a statement.

"We have been gradually developing a niche business providing clinical trial management and monitoring services to selected clients over the past 18 months," James Leslie, the company's president said. "The receipt of this contract ratifies the company's decision to pursue this market segment."
